title: PNCP Monitor input
description: Pick what to fetch (published in a period, or still open for proposals), narrow it down, and set a result limit. For a daily alert, turn on incremental mode and schedule the Actor.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Published in a period: every contratação published on the PNCP in the date window below (includes direct contracting). Open for proposals: tenders whose proposal period is still open today, the ones a supplier can still bid on.

lastDays.title: Last N days (published mode)
lastDays.description: Publication window: from N days ago up to today, Brasília time. 1 = yesterday and today. Ignored when 'Published from' is set.

dateFrom.title: Published from (optional)
dateFrom.description: Start of the publication window (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides 'Last N days'.

dateTo.title: Published until (optional)
dateTo.description: End of the publication window (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

proposalDeadlineTo.title: Proposal deadline up to (open mode, optional)
proposalDeadlineTo.description: Open-for-proposals mode only: keep tenders whose proposal deadline is on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: one year from today, which means every open tender.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.description: PNCP procurement modalities. Leave empty for all 13 (each one is a separate API query, so fewer is faster).

states.title: States (UF)
states.description: States of the buying agency's unit. Empty = the whole country.

municipalityIbgeCodes.title: Municipalities (IBGE codes)
municipalityIbgeCodes.description: 7-digit IBGE codes of the buying unit's city, for example 3550308 for São Paulo. When set, the state list is not used for the query.

agencyCnpjs.title: Agencies (CNPJ)
agencyCnpjs.description: CNPJ of the buying agency (órgão/entidade), with or without punctuation.

keywords.title: Keywords in the object
keywords.description: Keep only contratações whose object mentions at least one of these words or phrases. Case- and accent-insensitive, partial words match (notebook matches notebooks).

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop contratações whose object mentions any of these.

minValue.title: Minimum estimated value (R$)
minValue.description: Estimated total value in reais. With a value filter, contratações that do not disclose a value (orçamento sigiloso) are left out.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Stop after delivering this many contratações. You pay per result delivered, never for records that were filtered out.

incremental.title: Incremental mode (only new results)
incremental.description: Remember what this monitor already delivered and return only contratações that are new since the last run. Use it with a schedule. The memory lives in a key-value store named 'pncp-monitor-state' in your account.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Incremental mode keeps one memory per monitor name. Use a different name for each set of filters you schedule.

resetState.title: Forget what was delivered
resetState.description: Start this monitor from scratch: deliver everything that matches again and rebuild its memory.

maxApiPages.title: Maximum API pages
maxApiPages.description: Safety cap on PNCP pages read per run (50 records each, about 3 s per page because the portal limits request rates). Raise it for wide windows or broad keyword searches.
